# DISTILL-003 synthetic interview fixtures

These files are project-authored synthetic interview text and a locked 5-segment
distillation of that text. They are licensed for BookSkill tests only.

Do not copy unauthorized originals into this directory. Do not modify the
locked book fixtures or SHA256SUMS under `../distill/`.

- `合成访谈_决策节奏复盘.txt` is the source interview/text.
- `合成访谈_决策节奏复盘_蒸馏结果.md` is the expected locked 5-segment result.
- `SHA256SUMS` uses relative filenames for the two new files only.
